carryon_weight.value: 1 piece of hand baggage up to 7kg, plus a reasonable amount of reading material. No cabin-bag dimensions are given on the policy page.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Precision Air's excess baggage policy charges per kilo for bags over 23KGS, up to 32KGS.

size_weight.value: Bags over 23KGS but under 32KGS pay an extra charge per kilo. Bags over 32kgs and/or more than 158 cm need prior approval, and no bag may exceed 50KGS.
size_weight.notes: The policy's allowance tables did not survive capture cleanly, so per-route allowances are left unpublished.
